title: HackerRank: Drawing Book
description: A teacher asks the class to open their books to page `p`. A student can either start turning pages from the front (page 1) or from the back (page `n`). Each page turn opens two pages. Find and return the minimum number of page turns to get to page `p`.
starter_code:
def page_count(n: int, p: int) -> int:
    pass
explanation: Front turns equal p // 2; back turns equal (n // 2) - (p // 2). Minimum takes O(1) time.
